title: delissea bishopii
intro: Delissea bishopii, commonly known as Hawaiian Helele, is a flowering plant species in the heath family, Ericaceae. It has been traditionally used in Hawaiian medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant has been found to have health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations, wounds, and other infections. The bioactive constituents of Delissea bishopii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
